title: Offline Mode Checkpoint
decisions: Run a closed beta of offline mode with 200 users starting November 3
Defer attachments in offline mode to a later release

action_items.task: Recruit 200 beta users from the support ticket list
Add sync telemetry for conflict counts and sync latency

transcript:
Ava Chen: Where are we on offline mode?
Sam Okafor: The SQLite layer works, with encryption at rest. Reads are fast. The open problem is attachments: photos make the local database huge.
Marcus Bell: The version field is live in the sync API. Stale writes are rejected and logged to the audit table.
Priya Nair: I'd cut attachments from the first release. Text fields cover most of what users asked for.
Ava Chen: Agreed, attachments are deferred. Can we get real users on it soon?
Priya Nair: A closed beta starting November 3 with 200 users is realistic. I'll write the test plan.
Ava Chen: I'll recruit beta users from the support ticket list, starting with the people who complained about connectivity.
Sam Okafor: Before the beta I'll add telemetry for conflict counts and sync latency, so we can tell whether last-writer-wins is causing problems.
